example-reviewer.requirement_level_hint: some vendors gate on an org/repo review-strictness setting that isn't exposed via API; note here where to check it by hand (dashboard URL or setting name), or null if not applicable. Report it alongside the opt-in label, never in place of it: an opt-in label has been observed running a review at a level that nominally excludes it.
example-reviewer.request_notes: a metered vendor counts a full review against the whole diff and an incremental one only against changes since its last completed review: full_review_comment is posted for a PR's first pass only, rereview_comment for every request after it; set quota_refusal_regex to the vendor's real refusal wording so a quota stop is named, not read as silence

cli.invocation_notes: placeholder flags, findings_jq and env_allow; run the real CLI's --help and inspect one real findings file before first use, then correct the first two, and measure env_allow by running the CLI the way /panel-review's snippet does (see its Config the snippet reads)
example of a reviewer whose hosted bot is not installed on the repo's org: cli-only is valid, no hosted keys required
